thread:
emma_cs: Heads up - ThunderHarbor returned their security questionnaire. Top blockers: BYOK for embeddings, proof of vector deletion within 30 days, and a short SOC2 region extract. They said renewal review is on hold until these are addressed.

ralf_se: Ack. We have BYOK on Dedicated/Private only, not Hosted. We should be explicit about that.

emma_cs: Can we draft a one-paragraph answer for the customer's security team? Keep it clear but non-committal on Hosted.

nora_security: Suggested wording: `Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) on Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private deployments. Our Hosted API uses provider-managed keys; however, we can offer contractual retention commitments for Hosted customers on a case-by-case basis. For full SOC2 artifacts we require an NDA; redacted region information can be shared immediately.`

omar_success_eng: For the deletion proof ask: we can produce a redacted audit snippet from a Dedicated environment showing a vector delete event and the KMS key identifier. For Hosted customers we only have provider-managed lifecycle logs — no per-customer KMS ids.

emma_cs: ThunderHarbor specifically requested 30-day automatic purge and an auditable trail. If we promise Hosted retention by contract, do we need product changes?

claire_legal: Short answer: retention commitments can be contractually scoped for Hosted, but operational proof (KMS key IDs, provenance) depends on product capabilities. I'll draft a DPA amendment that offers a 30-day retention clause for embeddings with associated evidence types listed (audit export, deletion timestamp). We should make it explicit that BYOK is available only on Dedicated/Private.

cs-ops-bot: New ticket created: CS-6218 - "ThunderHarbor questionnaire: BYOK + 30d vector deletion" (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-6218)

emma_cs: Action items: 1) Ralf - paste Nora's wording + link to redacted SOC2 regions in a response to the customer. 2) Omar - prepare redacted Dedicated audit snippet and a 1-pager architecture + timeline. 3) Claire - draft Hosted retention addendum. 4) I'll mark account health to 'watch' and flag renewal as 'conditional' pending their reply.

ralf_se: Sending now. Message to customer: "Thanks for the questionnaire. Attached: redacted SOC2 region excerpt, our BYOK/retention guidance, and an example Dedicated config. Hosted has provider-managed keys; BYOK is available on Dedicated/Private. If BYOK is mandatory for renewal, let's schedule a 30-minute scoping call to discuss Dedicated timing." :envelope_with_arrow:

omar_success_eng: I'll have the audit snippet and a one-pager ready by tomorrow noon PT. It'll include a sample deletion event and the corresponding log fields (event_id, timestamp, key_id redacted).

claire_legal: Drafting addendum now. Will include fallback language that prevents us from promising Hosted BYOK and clarifies evidence types for deletion. Posting draft to CS-6218 when ready.

emma_cs: Thanks. I've set renewal probability to 'low -> conditional' and added CS-6218 to the renewals board. Will paste customer reply here when it comes.

nora_security: Internal note: Product roadmap shows BYOK for Dedicated is planned next quarter; Hosted BYOK is not scheduled. If customer pushes for Hosted, we need to quantify cost to accelerate.

emma_cs: Noted. We'll surface that if the customer asks. Closing for now."
